verdict.rationale: OpenHands documents hosted cloud access from mobile, and its CLI has an action-approval flow: auto-approve is an opt-out, which implies a default confirmation mode. Nothing shows these approvals can be given from a phone, or that agents keep working while a decision waits. Missing for 10: documented mobile approval/confirmation UI, approve-while-agent-continues (non-blocking) behavior, push notifications for pending decisions, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can approve key agent decisions from my phone while agents continue working

citations.quote: Hosted cloud access from desktop and mobile
